note: Help text for alerts that have none in rules.json (the overall alert and the patterns). Read by the detail view.

environment_overall.label: Overall: environment
environment_overall.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from this module's indicators; you do not measure it.
environment_overall.whyItMatters: It combines the module's signals into one status so no single reading raises an alert alone. Act means follow the suggested action and contact the flight surgeon.
environment_overall.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card. For Act, contact the flight surgeon.

infection_like.label: Possible infection-like pattern
infection_like.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from body temperature and sleep; you do not measure it.
infection_like.whyItMatters: A raised temperature together with poor sleep can be a possible early sign of infection. Looking at both together avoids an alert from one reading alone.
infection_like.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card and tell the flight surgeon if it continues.

infection_like_with_symptoms.label: Possible infection-like pattern with symptoms
infection_like_with_symptoms.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from body temperature, sleep and the symptom check-in; you do not measure it.
infection_like_with_symptoms.whyItMatters: A raised temperature, poor sleep and logged symptoms together can be a possible sign of infection. Looking at them together avoids an alert from one reading alone.
infection_like_with_symptoms.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card and contact the flight surgeon.
